_neutral_clinical_comment: DECIDED 2026-11-15 by the owner (review decision 3, finding C-M-08): Tier 1 is diagnostic and pathology vocabulary ONLY. 'therapy', 'patient', 'patients', 'condition' and 'trauma' were deliberately removed — they are this market's neutral vocabulary, so counting them made the client's own copy score as the medical model and made every 'couples therapy' query Tier 1 (67 of 374 real competitor keywords in competitor_keyword_gap.md are Tier 1 because of 'therapy' alone). Do not add them back without re-reading that decision. 'treatment', 'clinical' and 'healthcare' are arguable on the same test and were explicitly left in by that decision. Entries are LEMMAS: matching lemmatises the page text, so 'symptom' matches 'symptoms' and the plural entries were dropped.
